name: Banana Cat
blurb: A crying cat in a banana costume, the sad star of 2023 cat-meme story videos
title: Banana Cat Meme: Meaning, Origin & the Crying Banana Cat
description: Banana Cat is a crying cat in a banana suit, from photos shared on Facebook in March 2021; it starred in TikTok cat-meme stories in 2023.
h1: What is the Banana Cat meme?
answer: Banana Cat is a cat dressed in a banana costume, usually shown sad or crying, that became a recurring character in TikTok cat-meme story videos. The banana-suit cat images trace back to a Facebook compilation posted on 3 March 2021, and the crying version first appeared in a "Happy Happy Happy" cat video on 17 March 2023. It took off through 2023 as the character who bursts into tears whenever something goes wrong.

body: The image is a small cat with its face poking out of a yellow banana costume. In memes it is often edited to cry, with big tears, and placed in short animated or edited stories alongside other famous cat clips. The typical plot: cats dance happily to a cheerful song, something bad happens, Banana Cat cries, and things are resolved with the happy song again.

body.note: The cheerful soundtrack comes from the separate Happy Happy Happy Cat meme, a 2015 clip of a kitten hopping behind glass, set to "My Happy Song" by the children's channel Super Simple Songs. The real cat in the banana suit has not been clearly identified.

head: Date
Event
rows: A Facebook compilation of cats wearing banana suits is posted, getting thousands of shares.
Banana Cat first appears in a TikTok Happy Happy Happy Cat video, crying as a cat goes to hospital.
Fan art, 3D models and reposts spread; meme sites publish explainers asking who the Banana Cat is.
3D-printed figures and more edits appear as the character becomes a fixture of cat-meme stories.

ul: Cat-meme story videos where Banana Cat is the sensitive friend who cries at every problem.
Posting the crying image as a reaction to sad news, from failing a test to a lost game.
Fan art, 3D models and 3D-printed figures of the banana-suited cat.
Combining it with other cat clips such as Huh Cat or Happy Cat to tell a whole story.

body: Banana Cat peaked in 2023 but remains a familiar reaction image and a stock character in cat-meme storytelling videos on TikTok.

faq.a: Crying is its role in cat-meme stories: whenever something bad happens to its friends, Banana Cat bursts into tears.

faq.q: Where does Banana Cat come from?
faq.a: From photos of cats in banana costumes shared on Facebook in March 2021; the crying version appeared in TikTok cat stories in March 2023.

faq.q: What song plays in Banana Cat videos?
faq.a: Usually "My Happy Song" by Super Simple Songs, the soundtrack of the Happy Happy Happy Cat meme.
